title: Grateful Dead Live at Hollywood Palladium on 1972-09-09
source: mac > cass (u/k gen) > wav > flac > wav > flac

ai_review.summary: Great audience recording that captures long, hot jams on Playin', Truckin' and The Other One with a memorable Stars & Stripes encore.
ai_review.review: The tape offers a listenable audience sound – loud sections are clear while the keyboards slip into mush during quieter moments. Musically the show is a classic fall‑72 performance featuring extended jams, an impassioned Stella Blue, and a plucky Stars & Stripes finale despite Phil’s early exit.

ai_rating.rationale: Three consistent reviews (two 4‑star, one 5‑star) praise the show’s energy and jams while noting only minor recording quirks, yielding a solid above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Loud sections are clear and punchy; keyboards get lost in the mush during quiet passages, especially near the end of Playin'. Overall a listenable audience capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long, flowing jams with extended improvisations; a spacey section after The Other One and an energetic encore that kept the momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Featured in the plucky Stars & Stripes rendition; no specific performance critique beyond presence.
band_member_comments.Phil: Absent for most of the show, reportedly left backstage early.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keyboards become muffled in quieter sections, especially near the end of Playin'.
